# Tender response — Framework agreement for technical property maintenance (JMK-TEK-2026/09)

Visakoivu Oy

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds the F-Gas qualification required for works involving refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment. Our equity ratio, per our most recent financial statements, is comfortably above the 20% threshold in Section 3.4. We have completed a reference project meeting the higher value threshold under Section 3.3 within the qualifying period.

## Technical response

**Routine maintenance visits.** We propose a fixed annual visit calendar covering all four properties, with the standard scope of tasks confirmed at each visit through a signed visit report countersigned by the site contact.

**Fault response and standby.** Visakoivu operates a standby arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, with defined response-time commitments for reported faults.

**Access control and site security.** Personnel will observe the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures at all four properties, including working outside operating hours at the school and day-care sites wherever practicable.

**Statutory electrical inspection.** Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is carried out by our own certified electrical personnel on a schedule aligned with the applicable regulations.

**Environmental matters.** Waste is segregated by type at each site, hazardous substances are handled under our environmental management system, and spill-prevention measures are in place wherever fuels or refrigerants are handled.

**Occupational safety.** A site-specific occupational safety plan covering all four properties is enclosed.

**Building envelope inspection.** Roof, facade and window condition are inspected twice yearly at each property, with findings logged and reported to the contracting authority.

**Corrective maintenance response times.** Response times are tiered by fault category, from safety-critical faults through to non-urgent repairs.

**Personnel qualifications.** All personnel working on site, including subcontracted staff, hold the occupational cards and trade certificates the work requires.

## Commercial terms

We propose the standard cost-of-living index as the price adjustment mechanism for the contract term. We accept the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level is not met. Invoicing is proposed monthly.

## Format

Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year. The tender is submitted as a single PDF file. Font size throughout is 11pt or larger.

## Forms enclosed

Completed Tender Form (Liite 1); completed Reference Form (Liite 2); certificate of insurance confirming our cover.

## Annex A — Technical specification

HVAC systems are inspected quarterly, with ductwork in kitchen and food-preparation areas cleaned annually and measurements logged at each visit. Spare-parts availability and standard delivery times are confirmed for the installed building systems. Fire-protection systems — smoke detection, fire dampers and emergency lighting — are maintained on a defined schedule at each property. Lift maintenance is carried out under the applicable statutory periodic inspection regime.

## Annex B — Forms and commercial terms

We accept the retention terms set out in the draft contract.

Visakoivu Oy
